profile: Core design disposition of the compiled R2 declaration draft only; no production behavior, external owner, R4, C45 or freeze acceptance

answers.answer: Core selects all six numeric member intents and XdmExactDecimal as the review surface. Arbitrary-precision parsing, arithmetic, casts, map keys and serialization must be implemented coherently before support is claimed. Legacy signatures and wrong-kind checks remain; narrowing must reject overflow/inexactness, not silently round. Session digit/scale and output budgets are separate from caller allocation of an already-created BigInteger. The 1.42.0 production numeric implementation is unchanged and is not qualified for these new semantics. Record exact immutable normative adoption before W3 code.

Core retains governing list/union metadata, IsList for empty/singleton lists, ordered per-atomic declared/actual type and optional original assessment. Selected union type must be the actual chosen member. HasNoTypedValue and nil are not empty-list shortcuts. Exact snapshot-specific ReadTypedValue and provider issuance checks precede container getters. Fresh construction carries target evidence without fabricated original assessment. No additional Core signature is presently identified; Schema must validate authentic facts/representation against O1/O2 before joint closure.

Core retains the opaque identity, complete-closure/Unsupported, advisor/episode and effective-environment contracts under D07/D10/D12. Names/digests/labels do not authenticate components. IQueryStaticContext intentionally exposes only captured namespaces in this draft; full effective settings remain captured internally. This is not evidence that all future advisor consumers need only namespaces: Schema must name any required observable context member in O2, and a demonstrated required gap prevents R2 closure. Four isolated declaration assemblies establish compile shape, not actual provider feasibility.

Core selects endpoint/profile-bound directional compatibility preserving original PSVI. Compatible requires an explicit provider-qualified proof; supported Incompatible and Unsupported remain distinct. An unimplemented backend may return Unsupported with honest profile scope; it cannot synthesize a compatible view or rewrite original facts. Actual positive supported routes and intentional refusals need Schema evidence/R4 acceptance. This scoped Core design return does not close N1–N8 on another owner’s behalf.
